protocol.title: Digital Microfluidics with Impedance Sensing for Integrated Cell Culture and Analysis
protocol.platform: Digital microfluidics (DMF) with integrated impedance sensing
protocol.objective: Label-free impedance-based cell density sensing integrated with DMF for cell seeding, long-term culture, and multiplexed analysis via three assays: calibration, proliferation, and serum screening

top_plate.coating: Teflon-AF hydrophobic coating (patterned; hydrophilic ITO exposed at culture sites)

device.passive_dispensing: Unit droplet translated across hydrophilic ITO site -> spontaneous 0.2 uL virtual microwell formation (S1-S3 program)
device.reagent_exchange: Three-droplet sequential wash sequence (E1-E3 program) replaces microwell contents without disturbing cell monolayer
device.feedback_control: Impedance-based droplet position sensing (Vsense loop, Fig S1) repurposed for cell density measurement

impedance_system.measurement_medium: 500 mM aqueous sucrose (10 mM HEPES, 0.05% w/v Pluronic F68, pH 7.4)
impedance_system.rationale_for_sucrose: Low-conductivity medium separates density-dependent Vsense values; full cell media shows no statistically significant difference between densities
impedance_system.sucrose_viability_impact: None observed for any cell type tested
impedance_system.circuit_model: Capacitor (insulator) in series with parallel R-C (medium) and cell membrane/cytoplasm sub-circuit; modified from Morgan et al. 2007 to account for DMF insulator layer and electrode-adhered cells

cell_media.HeLa: DMEM + 10% FCS + 100 IU/mL penicillin + 100 ug/mL streptomycin + 0.05% w/v Pluronic F68
cell_media.NIH3T3: DMEM + 10% FCS + 100 IU/mL penicillin + 100 ug/mL streptomycin + 0.05% w/v Pluronic F68
cell_media.CHO_K1: 50/50 v/v F-12/DMEM + 10% FCS + 100 IU/mL penicillin + 100 ug/mL streptomycin + 0.05% w/v Pluronic F68

reagents.sucrose_buffer: 500 mM sucrose in DI water (18 MOhm cm), 10 mM HEPES, 0.05% w/v Pluronic F68, pH 7.4
reagents.trypsin_edta: 0.25% w/v trypsin + 1 mM EDTA (cell detachment before DMF experiments)
reagents.pluronic_f68_additive: 0.05% w/v Pluronic F68 in all cell suspensions (biofouling prevention)
reagents.fcs_stock_for_serum_assay: 20% FCS in serum-free DMEM (used as concentrated stock for on-chip serial dilution in serum screening assay)

steps.name: Cell seeding into virtual microwells (calibration)
steps.operation: passive dispensing (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.notes: S1-S3 passive dispensing: unit droplet (1 uL) driven over hydrophilic ITO site leaves 0.2 uL virtual microwell. Each of 9 conditions (3 lines x 3 densities) seeded in separate virtual microwells.

steps.name: Sucrose exchange and Vsense measurement (calibration)
steps.microscopy_validation: ImageJ cell count of surface density (Nc) and area occupied (Ac) for regression validation
steps.notes: QC gate keyed on NIH-3T3 high-density Vsense (highest expected signal; R2=0.9935). Sucrose exchange (E1-E3) is three-droplet wash abstracted as single mix step in BioScript.

steps.name: Cell seeding and 4-day proliferation monitoring
steps.operation: passive dispensing + periodic sucrose exchange + Vsense + media refresh
steps.cycle_per_timepoint: sucrose exchange (E1-E3) -> Vsense at 15 kHz -> media exchange (E1-E3) -> 24h culture at 37C

results.day_1: All cell lines below LOD (~20-25 cells/mm2)
results.days_2_to_4: Measurable surface densities obtained for all lines
results.ranking: NIH-3T3 and HeLa proliferate faster than CHO-K1; consistent with macroscale culture

steps.notes: QC gate keyed on NIH-3T3 Day 4 Vsense (highest expected surface density at experiment end). Vsense translated to surface density (cells/mm2) via calibration regression curves from S2.

steps.name: Serum screening assay (5-plex FCS dilution series)
steps.dilution_scheme: On-chip serial dilution (D1-D9 program): 20% FCS stock + serum-free DMEM diluent; each concentration independently dispensed and verified
steps.cycle_per_timepoint: sucrose exchange (E1-E3) -> Vsense at 15 kHz -> regenerate FCS droplets (D1-D9) -> media exchange -> 24h culture at 37C

results.5_pct_and_10_pct: Sigmoidal growth profiles; cells proliferate well
results.0_625_to_2_5_pct: Flat or declining profiles; poor proliferation

steps.notes: QC gate keyed on 10% FCS Day 4 Vsense (highest serum concentration; highest expected surface density). Serial dilution fully unrolled in BioScript (no loop support). Serum-free DMEM used as diluent throughout.

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Calibration assay: 3 cell lines x 3 densities; seeding, 24h culture, sucrose exchange, Vsense, microscopy count

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: Dispose all calibration Vsense and count signals; proliferation assay begins

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: Dispose all proliferation Vsense signals; serum screening assay begins

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_10_j
basic_blocks.content: Dispose all serum screening Vsense signals; NOP; experiment ends

bioscript_notes.ir_output: 10 basic blocks (BB1-BB10), 3 if/else gates, 12 CFG edges
bioscript_notes.duration_units: All durations in s or m only (h token not supported by compiler); 1440m = 86400s (24h culture); 360m = 21600s (6h attachment in serum assay)
bioscript_notes.virtual_microwell_abstraction: mix steps abstract passive dispensing (S1-S3) event; not electrode mixing
bioscript_notes.sucrose_exchange_abstraction: mix steps abstract E1-E3 three-droplet wash sequence
bioscript_notes.serial_dilution_note: BioScript has no loop or parametric dilution support; all 5 FCS concentration chains fully unrolled for each of 3 daily refresh cycles
bioscript_notes.qc_gate_note: Alias assignment (e.g. calibSignal = nih3t3High_Vsense) not supported by compiler symbol visitor; detect result variables used directly in if conditions
bioscript_notes.drain_vs_dispose_in_ir: drain and dispose both lower to dispose() in IR; semantically equivalent at compiler level
